verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an agent framework, which could ship batch runs or bulk-item APIs. The evidence shows only single-run primitives (Runner.run, run_sync, run_streamed), tools, handoffs and sessions. Nothing documents batch execution or bulk processing across many items, and running many async calls concurrently would be a developer building block rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
